name: Dathan
overview: The character Dathan appears in Scripture as a key conspirator alongside Korah and others who challenged the divinely appointed leadership of Moses and Aaron. In Numbers 16:1-3, Dathan and Abiram lead a rebellion, questioning Moses' authority by asserting that all the congregation is holy and that Moses is elevating himself above the people. This confrontation provokes Moses to seek the Lord’s judgment, highlighting the seriousness of opposing God's chosen leaders and the call to recognize His appointed authority.
